dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's that person?

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Huh, have you... never heard of the adventurer Herman before?

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: ...No, this must be your way provoking me to make a comeback. I've already seen through you!

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: It's a shame. As I am now, all I can do is provide younger adventurers like you with snippets of my experience. I don't go out on adventures anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I never said I was looking for you...

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Oh I see, I misunderstood. I thought you were another one of these who'd heard my story and came here to harass me about it.

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Look, whatever stories you've heard about Herman the adventurer, don't believe a word! ...Even the ones that are true.

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Because I'm not the same person anymore. No more starry-eyed "ad astra" adventurer for me; the only thing that catches my eye now is my wife. And no more conquering the abyss — not when I've got a daughter to deal with!

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: So long as they are in my life, I don't have the right to tempt fate by going on adventures anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Wagner's swords are all so expensive... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...?

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Who, me? Sorry, you must have the wrong guy; I'm certainly not who you're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: I'm just an ordinary dad on his way to the shops. See? Ordinary as can be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: My baby girl Ellin is almost old enough to sign up with the Knights of Favonius now. It's what she's always wanted to do...

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: I was going to give her a sword for her birthday this year, but it's so expensive...

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Maybe it's true that I've got nothing left going for me now I'm not an adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Especially now I've spent the last of the Mora I made when I forced myself to sell my trusty sword, Cool Steel, all those years ago...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Bye. If you come across a good way to make money, let me know. As long as it doesn't involve tempting fate, that is.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Stormterror? Are you asking me to...

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: No, no way. I'm not making a comeback!

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: Look at me. I... I already have a wife and a child. I have a daughter now. The adventurer Herman has nothing to do with me anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Herman
dialogues.text: My life doesn't belong to me alone any longer. Even if it's for their sake, I won't go on another adventure...
